# Field Treatment
## Wound selection
1. Select a body zone on the targeting doll. 2. Use the treatment item on the patient. 3. In [color=#58e6d9]Automatic[/color] mode, the server selects the most dangerous compatible external wound. 4. Verify the result with the analyzer or the [color=#58e6d9]Wounds[/color] tab.
## Direct pressure
- Item: empty hand. - Use: click a patient with external bleeding. - Effect: temporarily reduces flow from the selected wound.
## Dressing
- Item: [color=#58e6d9]Gauze[/color]. - Target: external wound. - Effect: controls capillary and venous flow and reduces arterial flow. - State: the dressing has sterility and absorption capacity consumed by blood.
## Hemostatic packing
- Item: [color=#58e6d9]Brutepack[/color]. - Target: deep external wound. - Effect: stronger local hemostasis.
## Tourniquet
- Item: [color=#58e6d9]Tourniquet[/color]. - Target: arm or leg. - Effect: occludes external bleeding sources distal to the selected region. - State: records installation time, ischemia onset, and critical ischemia. - Removal: prepare a dressing, hemostatic packing, and volume replacement, then remove it under control.
## Splint
- Item: [color=#58e6d9]NCFieldSplint[/color]. - Target: fractured limb. - Effect: improves bone stability and reduces secondary movement damage.
External blood loss removes fluid from the real [color=#58e6d9]bloodstream[/color] solution. After controlling the source, check blood volume and perfusion.
